items.title: Elvin Jones — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I called up Jimmy Garrison, I called up Joe Farrell, and I knew him very well so we got a trio together and I got a trio.

ctx.x: Well, I think I heard Keiko mention earlier that was in March of 1966. What happened after that?

Well, when that tour was over I came back to New York. We talked about…I said, “I should get a group of my own, I’m tired of playing with everybody else.” Anyway, I found that. I called up Jimmy Garrison, I called up Joe Farrell, and I knew him very well so we got a trio together and I got a trio.
